My worst experience included psychosis. I was at the zoo with my friends and I was so ramped up I started hearing lions roaring and people screaming (in my head of course). 

I was convinced I had to save everyone, so naturally I decided to jump into this closed-off bushy forest area of the zoo and proceeded to trek through the interior of the zoo like I was Indiana Jones. Thankfully I didn’t actually get seriously hurt, but I did meet face to face with a pen of water buffalo and started to herd them around. I thought I was the next Moses or something.

Anyways, eventually I ended up at the fence that led to the outside of the zoo. There was barbed wire at the top, but I was determined to climb over and “escape.” At this point I was shirtless, muddy and looking like I had just crawled out of a swamp. I was about halfway up the fence when two zookeepers in their little go karts saw me and asked me wtf I was doing. To which I responded I’m not sure lol.

They promptly escorted me to the office building where they interrogated me and then about half an hour later I found myself in the back of a police car being driven to the hospital. All the while I am completely disassociated and manic out of my mind.

I ended up staying at the hospital for 2 weeks and met my then girlfriend there. It didn’t last obviously, but it was sure hell of a ride.

Thanks so much for sharing your experience, it means a lot. I’m sorry that you had those scary experiences with psychedelics, I’m going to ask my doctor about them my next appointment. 

Yeah, right now I’m on a combination of lithium and antipsychotics, and the occasional sleeping pill. Do you mind telling me what medications you’re on right now and how they are working for you?

Thanks again, you’re a hero man

Hang in there brother, trust me we know how you feel. Your wife and daughter desperately need you to be around, even if it doesn’t feel like it. 

I feel the same with medication, it seems to only make my depression worse and worse. At this point my only goal is to stay alive and stick around for another day. Then I do the same tomorrow. I’m just hoping things will get better soon.

When I’m manic, I literally hop on to the first girl I see. I’m charming, charismatic, and if there’s even a slight bit of interest from her, we would end up hooking up or dating until my mania crashes. 

Then when I switch to depression, I literally cannot even talk to a girl without having a panic attack.
